chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿUbayd Allāh informed me, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from his father, from Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā, from Mūsā ibn ʿUmar, from Yaḥyā ibn ʿUmar, from Dāwūd al-Raqqī, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the urine of bats that gets onto my garment, and I look for it but do not find it. He said: “Wash your garment.”

key_terms.اغْسِلْ: wash; the Imam’s direct legal instruction
key_terms.الْخَشَاشِيفِ: bats; the animal whose urine is under discussion
key_terms.بَوْلِ: urine; the substance being asked about as a source of impurity
key_terms.ثَوْبَكَ: your garment; the object that must be washed
key_terms.ثَوْبِي: my garment; the clothing affected by the impurity
key_terms.فَأَطْلُبُهُ: then I search for it; the act of trying to locate the impurity

ai.seo_question: What should be done if bat urine gets on clothing but its exact place cannot be found?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding impurity on clothing from the urine of bats. Even if the exact spot cannot be found after searching, the garment is to be washed, indicating caution in matters of taharah for acts of worship.
